svg.title: Unburden Root
svg.desc: Unburden Root, the harness I work in every day. Diagram: Claude Code sessions run as named roles (orchestrator, lane, reviewer) through a core of hooks, persistent memory and written rulings, then a PII guard that fails closed, then a router that sends work to model pools by cost and urgency. Animated: work flows through; a request carrying PII is blocked at the guard. Private; a write-up will follow.
